RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

At 2.0p.m., 12-4-32, D.S. Karmorate of the French Police came to the Station and requested assistance to search the premises of one, Chin Tse In( ), 22, S/Student of the Chin Nan University, Hart Road, who was arrested at the Avenue Joffre Police Station at 11.30a.m. the 12-4-32 on a charge of being a communist.
C.D.S. 154 and the undersigned, rendered the necessary assistance and proceeded with the French Police and the Accused, first to 24, Hen Teh Lee, Hart Road, and then to a room occupied by the Accused in the China Realty Company's Refugee Camp on the Corner of Hart and Sinza Roads.
Both places were searched but no literature or other matter of a communistic nature was found.
Special Branch were communicated with before the search was conducted.
